text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: "‘Champions Cup’... Champions..."

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. There used to be lots of 
champions on dirt in the past, wasn't 
there?

Ever since running alongside Hokko 
Tarumae, Wonder Acute had been concerned 
about the Umamusume of the past. That was 
why...

Before the race. I came to the exhibition 
hall adjacent to Chukyo Racecourse. The 
theme of the exhibit is—

"‘Champions Cup ~Hoofprints of the Dirt 
Umamusume~’"

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Hmm? Once upon a time, the 'Champions Cup' 
was called the 'Japan Cup Dirt'...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
And the Japan Cup Dirt branched off from 
the Japan Cup...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. Was the Champions Cup called the 
Japan Cup in the past?

The "Japan Cup Dirt" was newly created by 
splitting from the "Japan Cup" to attract 
dirt Umamusume from around the world.

"That was the very origin of the Champions 
Cup."

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Well now~, that's quite a surprise. And 
there were so many different champions on 
the dirt too, huh...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Like that girl who went from Ohi to the 
Central League and made it big...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Oh, this dirt Umamusume is...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
You competed against the President in the 
Japan Cup? And with a name like a boxer's, 
too...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
There was also an Umamusume who recklessly 
front-ran just to get on TV, and a general 
who ran non-stop...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
There were so many bright and cheerful 
Umamusume there, wasn't there?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: But...

Upon looking at a certain column, their 
face suddenly darkened. That column 
was—"Career Record."

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Not everyone left on clean terms, it 
seems.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
7th place... 5th place... 17th place... 
Until she could no longer compete for the 
win at all...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Even if it hurts... even if you can't run 
the way you want to, you have to give it 
your all until the very end...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Trainer... This is... This is truly it...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: ...Champ-eon?
choice_data_list: Yeah, this is the real thing.
Yeah, I believe this is the real deal.

text_block_list.text:
Ascend the throne. And protect it. 
Defending it with all her might, even if 
her body and soul burn away to ash, still—

Grabbing the sand and standing back up. 
Our predecessors showed us that very 
strength with their backs.

That is why, even stripped of strength, 
they are called this: —"Champion."

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Run... until I can't run anymore... If 
this is what an honorable champion does...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"I thought I had reached it once before, 
but... I'm still not there..."
Wonder Acute was deep in thought.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I really thought I'd done everything I 
could. Helping everyone get back on their 
feet, running with Tarumae-chan...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I really thought I had shown it to them 
properly. And yet...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Have I not fully demonstrated it, I 
wonder...? The resolve to keep pushing 
forward without collapsing, even after 
reaching the mountain peak...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: To demonstrate that...
choice_data_list: We have to become a true champion.
We have to become a true champion.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: The real... Trainer, I'm still not...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I feel like there's still something I 
haven't managed to tell her. To 
Tarumae-chan, that is.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Acute-san, please! Today I'll go even 
further than before!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, me too... ...It's a little different 
from before.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I realized there are still things I 
haven't conveyed. And that surely is...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
The feelings that Falco-san understood, 
which I had been blind to...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"So, I... have to convey that to 
Tarumae-chan clearly through my running."

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Tarumae-chan. No one knows who will win, 
but let's aim for the top together. In 
today's race...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
A champion that everyone can genuinely 
look up to from the bottom of their 
hearts.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: —Yes!

Past champions ran until their bodies 
practically turned to sand. Compared to 
them, Wonder Acute is still the very 
picture of health.

"If so, then for their sake as well— I 
shall offer a run with no regrets. To the 
predecessors who built the history of dirt 
racing."
